case_name: Sanat Kumar Agarwal vs Smt. Nandini Agarwal
facts_of_case: The parties belong to the Agarwal Community of Chhatisgarh region in Madhya Pradesh. The custom 'GURAWAT' resulted in matrimonial casualty between two families. The couple, along with their sister-in-law and mother-in-law, tried to resolve the friction but ultimately Nandini and Shakuntala remained at their parents' houses.

legal_principles.principle: The question of desertion is a matter of inference to be drawn from the facts and circumstances of each case.
legal_principles.held: It is well settled that the question of desertion is a matter of inference to be drawn from the facts and circumstances of each case and those facts have to be viewed as to the purpose which is revealed by those facts or by conduct and expression of intention, both interior and subsequent to the actual act of separation.

legal_principles.principle: The purpose revealed by the facts or conduct and expression of intention is crucial in determining desertion.
legal_principles.held: Those facts have to be viewed as to the purpose which is revealed by those facts or by conduct and expression of intention, both interior and subsequent to the actual act of separation.
